────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Claude in Chrome

  Claude in Chrome works with the Chrome extension to let you control your
  browser directly from Claude Code. You can navigate websites, fill forms,
  capture screenshots, record GIFs, and debug with console logs and network
  requests.

  Site-level permissions are inherited from the Chrome extension. Manage
  permissions in the Chrome extension settings to control which sites Claude
  can browse, click, and type on (https://clau.de/chrome/permissions).

  For more info, use /chrome or visit https://code.claude.com/docs/en/chrome

  Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
